text: Why is the total wrong in @src/checkout/cart.ts? See also docs/pricing.md

The total was summed in floats. I rounded it in `src/checkout/cart.ts:14`, where `total` returns.

- The tax rule lives in `tax.ts` (lines 3-8: `src/checkout/tax.ts:3-8`).
- Prices are documented in docs/pricing.md#L5.
- The generated catalog, `src/data/catalog.json`, is big: `catalog.json:52000`.
- Ignored builds are in `build/` and node_modules/left-pad/index.js.
- Not linked: /etc/hosts, ../outside.md, `FileIndex.matches`, version 1.2.3, me@example.com and https://example.com/src/checkout/cart.ts.
